business_summary: Nac Co., Ltd. engages in rental and sale of dust control products in Japan. It operates through Kurikura Business, Rental Business, Architectural Consulting Business, Housing Business, and Beauty and Health Business segments. The Kurikura business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of home delivery water, purified water servers, and hypochlorous acid solutions. The Rental Business segment engages in the rental and sales of dust control products, nursing care products, and welfare equipment, as well as pest control devices, regular cleaning services, and restoration work. The Architectural consulting business segment sells and constructs construction-related know-how products and construction materials to local builders, consulting services, and housing franchise business.The Housing Business is involved in the construction contracting for custom-built detached houses; sales of condominiums; and related financial services. The Beauty and Health Business segment manufactures and sells cosmetics, health food, beauty materials, and pharmaceuticals. It also offers financial services related to custom-built detached houses; import and sale of alcoholic beverages and Korean food products. The company was formerly known as Duskin Tsurugawa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nac Co., Ltd. in 1977. Nac Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
business_summary_ko: NAC Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 먼지 제어 제품의 임대 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 쿠리쿠라 사업, 임대 사업, 건축 컨설팅 사업, 주택 사업, 미용 및 건강 사업 분야를 통해 운영됩니다. 쿠리쿠라 사업부문은 택배수, 정수서버, 차아염소산수 등의 제조 및 판매를 담당하고 있습니다. 렌탈사업부문은 먼지퇴치용품, 간호용품, 복지용품 등의 렌탈 및 판매, 해충방제기기, 정기청소, 복원작업 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 건축컨설팅 사업부문은 지역 건설업자, 컨설팅 서비스, 주택 프랜차이즈 사업 등을 대상으로 건설 관련 노하우 제품 및 건축 자재를 판매 및 시공합니다. 콘도 판매; 및 관련 금융 서비스. 미용건강사업부문은 화장품, 건강식품, 미용소재, 의약품 등을 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 맞춤형 단독주택과 관련된 금융서비스도 제공합니다. 주류 및 한국산 수입판매업
